channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Stephen Silas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Stephen Silas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Monty Williams on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Williams on Stephen Silas, who's going to be his top assistant:

“It's amazing how we fell into him coming in here... I think he's someone that will call me up when I get off track. I think he's someone who can relate to the loneliness of the head coaching position.”

Monty Williams on Stephen Silas, Jun 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Monty Williams on Stephen Silas
item.description:
James Edwards III:Williams on Stephen Silas:

“We all know he's a great coach. Had a situation in Houston like this that is young, had to navigate.”

Monty Williams on Stephen Silas, Jun 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Stephen Silas
item.description:
GM Rafael Stone:

“I have great respect for Stephen both as a person and as a basketball mind. His character, leadership, and positivity have been invaluable during this stage of our growth.”

Rafael Stone on Stephen Silas, Apr 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Stephen Silas
item.description:
David Hardisty:Rafael Stone on why Stephen Silas is no longer the coach:

“I think we thought it was time for a new voice. It was nothing to do with Stephen. It was much more about exiting one stage, entering another and (finding) the optimal way to move forward.”

Rafael Stone on Stephen Silas, Apr 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Jalen Green on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Green said during his postgame press conference.

“Today, Coach [Stephen Silas] got on us for not having our mind in shootaround. He and I went over film before and just broke that down. We were trying to see where I could do better coming off the double team and getting my guys involved better, and getting the ball back in my hands.”

Jalen Green on Stephen Silas, Jan 24, 2023. Source: Rockets Wire.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Mark Berman:Tom Thibodeau on the job being done by Stephen Silas:

“Terrific.. It’s not easy,but he’s so steady & I think that demeanor is important. I think he understands where he is. Stephen has a lot of experience. U need a teacher. U need patience with a young group like this & he has it”

Tom Thibodeau on Stephen Silas, Dec 31, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Garrison Mathews on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Rockets guardGarrison Mathews on having Stephen Silas back:

“We’ve all been praying for him & thinking about him & his family. It’s obviously a tough time for him. I was happy..to get that win for him (over the Bucks).Hopefully we’ll get another 1 for him tonight”

Garrison Mathews on Stephen Silas, Dec 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: John Lucas on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:John Lucas on his conversation with Stephen Silas since the Rockets' win yesterday:

“He was better. I told him guys really played hard for him to get that win.'Take care and we got it until you get back.' He was in as good a spirits as you can be in these circumstances.”

John Lucas on Stephen Silas, Dec 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: John Lucas on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Rockets ass’t coach John Lucas on Stephen Silas out due to health & safety protocols:

“Obviously we miss him because he’s our leader. We just got thru practice today, followed his game plan. Gonna talk to him today about what he wants to do tomorrow.. We have a system in place.”

John Lucas on Stephen Silas, Oct 4, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Kelly Iko:Fertitta:

“I love how Stephen Silas has grown as a coach. He’s an excellent X’s and O’s guy. I love seeing him get thrown out of games, seeing that fire in his belly.”

Tilman Fertitta on Stephen Silas, Jun 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @KellyIkoNBA.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Luka Doncic on ex-Mavs assistant Stephen Silas, who is now in charge of guiding the Rockets’ rebuild:

“He’s a great guy, and he deserves that spot in Houston. I think he’s doing a great job there, and all the players trust him. He’s an amazing coach.”

Luka Doncic on Stephen Silas, Oct 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Stephen Silas
item.description:
“Silas has just shown a great ability to develop these guys, and he's had thrown at him something that's unprecedented: To have 29 guys play for a team -- and play real minutes,”

Tilman Fertitta on Stephen Silas, May 12, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kelly Olynyk on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Kelly Olynyk on Stephen Silas:

“He's been awesome... His communication has been great, on the court and off the court. I love playing for him. His system and philosophies are in line with mine... I'd love to have the chance to learn, grow, and play under his system more.”

Kelly Olynyk on Stephen Silas, May 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Kelly Olynyk on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Kelly Olynyk on Stephen Silas:

“He's one of the best basketball minds that this game has to offer. He knows what he's talking about. He's diligent, he works hard. Guys enjoy playing for him... One thing you can say is that guys are playing hard..that's a testament to him and who he is.”

Kelly Olynyk on Stephen Silas, May 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rockets GM Rafael Stone:

“Stephen [Silas] has been exactly who we thought he’d be. He’s been great.”

Rafael Stone on Stephen Silas, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Christian Wood on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Adam Spolane:Christian Wood:

“My relationship with Stephen is, I came here for him. He brought me in, and to speak on yesterday, you would never want to see a head coach like that. I'd rather see my head coach how his face was today after this win than how it was yesterday..”

Christian Wood on Stephen Silas, Mar 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @AdamSpolane.

item.title: John Wall on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Adam Spolane:Wall on his relationship with Silas:

“We talk a lot, we text a lot. Sometimes on the road we meet, have conversations about certain things we see and what we like. He's a great person, great guy, great coach andI just hate he's has to go through all the adversity...”

John Wall on Stephen Silas, Mar 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @AdamSpolane.

item.title: Victor Oladipo on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Victor Oladipo on Stephen Silas:

“He just has a great personality and spirit to him. I'm looking forward to playing for him. We can do something very special here, we just gotta continue to buy into it. The sky is the limit if we continue to do that.”

Victor Oladipo on Stephen Silas, Jan 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Carlisle on Houston situation:

“I'm not privy to the internal goings-on there . . . My feeling is Stephen has done a great job of working through a lot of distractions there.. . That team's done very well considering everything that's going on.”

Rick Carlisle on Stephen Silas, Jan 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: James Harden on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Mark Berman:James Harden on Stephen Silas:

“Coach is doing an unbelievable job of communicating with the guys and putting the structure in.”

James Harden on Stephen Silas, Dec 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Michael C. Wright:DeMarcus Cousins:

“It's a lot of different looks for me in the offense. That's something that I do enjoy in coach Silas' offense.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Stephen Silas, Dec 9, 2020. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: PJ Tucker on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Salman Ali:PJ Tucker on Stephen Silas:

“Coach is great. He's been really reliable in his short time here. He's been kind of a open book in his short time here.”

PJ Tucker on Stephen Silas, Dec 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Christian Wood on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Christian Wood:

“I've talked to Coach Silas already... He's still keeping the same 5-out offense.”

Christian Wood on Stephen Silas, Nov 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Salman Ali:Rafael Stone:

“Stephen was the most prepared guy we talked to... We talked to really, really smart qualified guys.”

Rafael Stone on Stephen Silas, Nov 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Paul Silas on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Mark Berman:Paul Silas on son Stephen named #Rockets head coach:

“He is a special coach. He was with me for a long time (as an ass’t). Stephen has paid his dues. He’s been doing a heck of a job & I’m so happy. When he starts working I told him I’m gonna go down there & see what he’s doing.”

Paul Silas on Stephen Silas, Oct 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Paul Silas on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Mark Berman:Paul Silas on son Stephen named the #Rockets head coach:

“He’s gonna be good. Man oh man, he’s got a good job. It’s wonderful. I talked to him last week and I said Stephen this is gonna happen. I know it’s gonna happen and it did. He said dad you were right. I’m so happy for him.”

Paul Silas on Stephen Silas, Oct 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Stephen Silas
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on Stephen Silas:

“A great hire for the Rockets. Stephen did a great job for us here in Dallas helping us get back to the playoffs. Thrilled for him and his family.”

Rick Carlisle on Stephen Silas, Oct 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.
